data.name: Muniif
data.gender_notes: Muniif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-f-n', meaning to be kind and generous, to bestow, to grant, to forgive and pardon. The name Muniif signifies one who is righteous and generous, a giver and a forgiver. The name Muniif carries the meaning “Generous, Benevolent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muniif usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, benevolent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Muniif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Benevolent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muniif total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: منيف
in_arabic.meaning: المنيف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني العزيز الغني
in_arabic.long_meaning: المنيف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى المذكورة في القرآن الكريم، ويعني العزيز الغني الذي لا يحتاج إلى شيء، وهو اسم يدل على عظمة الله وغناه الكامل. وقد ورد اسم الله المنيف في القرآن الكريم في سورة الجمعة: 'وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ اللَّهُ الْمَنِيعُ' (الجمعة: 12).

in_urdu.name: منیف
in_urdu.meaning: منیف اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، مطلب ہے عزت یافتہ اور دولت مند
in_urdu.long_meaning: منیف اللہ کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام عزت یافتہ اور دولت مند کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ اللہ کی شان و عظمت اور اس کی دولت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुनिफ
in_hindi.meaning: मुनिफ़ अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है सम्मानित और धनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुनिफ़ अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है जो कुरआन में उल्लिखित है। यह नाम सम्मानित और धनी के अर्थ में है। यह अल्लाह की महानता और उसकी पूर्ण संपदा को दर्शाता है।

historical_references.context: Marwan II was a significant figure in the Umayyad Caliphate during a period of political instability and military conflict. His rule was marked by a focus on cultural achievements, particularly in the areas of literature and scholarship. The title 'Al-Muniifi' reflected his reputation for generosity and his support of the Muslim intellectual tradition.

historical_references.reference: Another historical figure known as Al-Muniifi was the Persian poet, Sana'i Ghaznavi (1111-1131 CE). He was a prominent Sufi mystic and writer, and the title 'Al-Muniifi' was given to him in recognition of his charitable deeds and his efforts to promote social justice.
historical_references.context: Sana'i Ghaznavi was a major figure in the development of Persian Sufism, a mystical and spiritual movement that emphasized the inner meaning of Islamic teachings. His writings and teachings emphasized the importance of compassion and generosity, and he is known for his many charitable acts and his efforts to promote social justice. The title 'Al-Muniifi' reflects his reputation as a compassionate and generous figure.
